selectionPlan.note: Declared paper costs include stock sell stamp duty 0.05% and stock transfer 0.001% per side; ETF secondary trades have neither. Commission is an assumption. No order-book fills.

notes: 预测目标为信号次日开盘至20交易日后开盘的后复权收益。
标准化仅拟合训练样本；RSI采用最近14次涨跌简单均值。
参考区间为训练残差10%至90%分位，不代表置信保证。

validation.criterion: 2024年冻结样本外平均绝对误差；未按2025/2026结果调参

session.note: Automatic paper experiment, frozen model and forecasts. Recheck the same entry plan; exit signal when price reaches the frozen 20-day estimated target, subject to T+1. No forced sale at thirty minutes. Last-price hypothetical execution, not broker fills. Cash is not prediction success.
